description: O'Donnellan & Joyce Auctioneers are delighted to offer for sale this excellent semi-detached residence in the ever-popular & well-established area of The Rise in Knocknacarra. No.30 The Rise is a spacious semi-detached home with approximately 135.2 sq.m over two storeys, well-presented throughout & offers an exceptional garden space. The ground floor is arranged via a large entrance hall with under-stairs guest bathroom, leading to a front living room, study/dining-room, separate kitchen, utility and a spacious front room that offers a variety of uses including a downstairs bedroom, further living room, study or rec-room. Upstairs is configured between four sizeable bedrooms, all offering fitted wardrobes & the main bedroom availing of its own en-suite, and main family bathroom. The proeprty is offered to the market in good condition having been well maintained by the current owner. Updated high-brightness lighting has been installed throughout the property. A key feature of no.30 The Rise is the outside space on offer. The corner position allows for a substantial & deep private rear garden with mature greenery, whilst the front of the home offers off-street parking. The Rise is a popular residential estate situated in the Knocknacarra area. Constructed in 1988, no.30 The Rise is ideally positioned with a cul-de-sac setting making it a perfect family-friendly environment. The location offers plenty of outdoor landmarks & facilities nearby including McGrath's Field, Cappagh Playing Fields, Barna Woods, Silverstrand & Salthill Promenade. The area is well serviced by regular transport links on the Shangort Road, as well as being within walking distance to local primary & secondary schools. A host of amenities are nearby including Gateway Retail Park, Tesco & local stores on the Shangort Road. No.30 The Rise will be an ideal property for a variety of purchasers looking to avail of good quality accommodation, excellent outdoor space, well-presented throughout with further potential. Viewing is highly recommended. Keep up to-date with NEW PROPERTIES by registering your details on our database For Further details please contact our office on 091-564212 OFFICE OPENING HOURS - MON TO FRI 9AM TO 5:30PMProperties can be viewed on our website www.odj.ie NOTE:  These particulars are not to be considered a formal offer.
